standard-dialogue.player: Hey there, what's with all the shouting.

standard-dialogue.npc: Our all-powerful Lord Zamorak is looking for the strongest of champions, you hardly look like you fit that criteria.

standard-dialogue.player: I am big and strong, what does he need new champions for?

standard-dialogue.npc: The glorious battlefield of Castle Wars, where we can smite down the weak followers of Saradomin needs new blood.

steps.player: That sounds neat, I'll be a champion for Zamorak.

steps.npc: Bring death to Saradomin in his great name.

steps.text: If the player has non-combat items in their inventory:
Some items are stopping you from entering the Castle Wars waiting area. See the chat for details.
You can't take non-combat items into the arena.
If the player has anything equipped in the head or cape slot:
Some items are stopping you from entering the Castle Wars waiting area. See the chat for details.
You can't wear hats, capes, or helms in the arena.
If the player does not have any prohibited items:
The player is teleported to the current world's Zamorak Castle Wars lobby.

steps.player: He can find a champion somewhere else, I'll pass.

steps.npc: Fool, you'll regret this one day.

on-seasonal-or-permanent-deadman-mode-wo.text: Sorry, you can't play Castle Wars on this world. Try world 334 for the official world.

steps.npc: Saradomin is weak, use your strength where it's respected!
Your Lord Zamorak needs your help!
